name: Hikawa (Shimane, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Hikawa town emblem in red: a ring open at the upper fly with three curved strokes.
history: Flag of the former town of Hikawa in Shimane Prefecture, dissolved on 2011-10-01. The municipal emblem was adopted on 27 May 1956.

features.role: Hikawa town emblem — a ring open at the upper fly with three curved strokes
